name: My Future Wife
source:
Do you believe in time travel? If you don't, let me tell you my story. Well, I was 18 years old and I was in my last year in high school. The special thing about me was that I could travel... 30 seconds into the future.

I didn't know why. It just started to happen when I masturbated the very first time. When I stared at anything without blinking (at that time, I focused on the girl's boobs when I was watching porn), I could see what would happen in the next 30 seconds (my mom would open the door without knocking). Well, I couldn't cheat on any tests or become rich by lottery or anything with just only 30 seconds into the future.

One day, Ha-Young Kim, a girl in my class, asked me if she could become a great singer in the future. I motivated her, trying to be cool. But after I looked into her eyes for some seconds, I saw myself 7 years in the future. And wow! Ha-Young would become my wife. But... The future is so fragile. It could be changed with just a small mistake...

translation:
你相信时间旅行吗？如果你不这样做，让我告诉你我的故事。嗯，当时我18岁，正在上高中最后一年。我的特别之处在于我可以旅行…… 30秒到未来。

我不知道为什么。当我第一次自慰时，这种情况就开始发生。当我不眨眼地盯着任何东西时（当时看色情片时我的注意力集中在女孩的胸部），我可以看到接下来的30秒会发生什么（我妈妈会开门而不敲门）。嗯，我不能在任何考试中作弊，也不能通过彩票或任何在未来30秒内的事情致富。

有一天，我们班的一名女生Ha-Young Kim问我她将来是否可以成为一名伟大的歌手。我激励她，努力表现得很酷。但当我看着她的眼睛几秒钟后，我看到了7年后的自己。哇！夏英将成为我的妻子。但是……未来是如此脆弱。只要一个小错误就可以改变它……
